svg.aria-label: Block diagram of a future plug-in box: vehicle power through surge protection and a buck converter to an ESP32-class MCU, a plus or minus 200 g accelerometer, a six-axis IMU, an LTE and GNSS modem with SIM, a cancel button and buzzer, an optional CAN link, and a backup supercapacitor; it sends the same packet to the same server. Roadmap only, not built.
svg.title: Roadmap: plug-in crash box, block diagram
